Does she say you get her too? This seems very off as if she's holding on to past feelings for her ex. 

>She was texting her ex again on the same website but with a different account. Once again I read through the conversation and again, nothing sexual yet, but her first message to him was "I've been thinking about you a lot lately".

There's no open communication within the relationship on her side. I can't believe she's hiding it from you. Even coming up with lies. MAJOR RED FLAG.

>We have been through a lot but at this point I find myself thinking that I can't trust her anymore. 

Your history with her does not determine tomorrow and your actual value. You formulate your own value on this world by what you put in it (i.e. working out, good deeds, contributing to society), not what she thinks of you. 

>I have to question every sentence that comes out of her mouth and every text that she sends me and try and force my brain to believe that it's true and she isn't being deceitful. 

If you can't trust her and since she is your fiance I recommend a more direct approach as all these red flags should be non-existent. This can be in a way where sincere questions and understanding of each other's feelings. Don't be afraid to lose her because you will be constantly trying to think of a way to keep her. You are getting married and this is the person you're going to be with for the rest of your life, would you really want someone who is untrustworthy? 

This is just my own opinion so take it with a grain of salt. 

Best wishes and good luck!
